Maya: quick heads-up — I'm on PTO Tue-Fri next week. Need to hand primary to Alex for that window. Also Priya (new to oncall) wants to shadow for a shift — can we slot her for a daytime shadow during Alex's primary?

Alex: yup I can take primary. Maya — can you drop any neat-to-know runbook pointers before you go?

Maya: sure — main things: 1) paging thresholds live in /runbooks/paging-config.md, 2) API 502 troubleshooting flow is under /runbooks/api-502.md (check nginx + model-proxy), 3) if KV cache warmup fails, follow the cache-warmup section.

Priya: happy to shadow! prefer Tue-Wed day shift. never paged before but read the runbooks once.

Daniel: fyi we had a small pager earlier today — incident-bot posted a 502 spike on prod-us-east. Resolved by scaling a pool, but good to review the steps with Priya.

incident-bot: [ALERT] 1790001200 - prod-us-east - 502 spike - 90m - severity: P2 - affected: /v1/generate (sampled 3% requests failed). Pager: oncall@redwood. Link: https://redwood.infra/incidents/1790001200

Maya: tagging the quick mitigation we used earlier: scaled dedicated-pool-3 by +2 GPUs, cleared prefix cache for the hot tenant, and rolled back an in-flight model variant.

Alex: thanks. For shadowing, let's do Tue 09:30-12:30 UTC for Priya. I'll be primary, Daniel secondary. Jordan you good as backup?

Jordan: I can be backup for the Tue window.

Priya: Tue 09:30 works. What should I watch for during the shadow?

Alex: primary things: 1) watch the incident-bot channel for pages, 2) look at latency/cost dashboard (Console -> Routes -> /v1/generate), 3) check model pool capacity (infra/gpu-pools). If a page triggers, follow the runbook steps in order — don't try random rollouts.

Alex: I'll paste the short checklist we use in triage:

```
Quick triage checklist
1) Confirm scope: single route or platform-wide
2) Check model pool utilization: `kubectl -n inference get hpa` & `redis-cli info` for KV cache
3) Inspect recent deploys: /deploys?since=1h
4) If transient 502s and pool saturated -> scale pool
5) If increased errors after model change -> rollback variant
6) Notify customer-success for any tenant impact > 1% error rate
```

Maya: add one more: if you scale, wait 3-5min for warmup then watch token success rate. Also ensure to update the incident page with actions and ETA.

Priya: should I be posting in the thread if I just observe, or only when I take action?

Daniel: post short notes either way. helps create context for the handoff later. e.g., `Priya observing: saw 502s spike at 09:45, Alex scaling pool` — small messages are fine.

Alex: onboarding plan for the shadow: 1) walk Priya through dashboards 09:30-10:00, 2) simulate a minor page locally using the replay tool 10:15-10:30 (no prod impact), 3) live shadow until 12:30. I'll assign small tasks (log grep, updating incident page) to Priya.

Maya: tagging runbook links: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/api-502 and https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/oncall-checklist — Priya, skim those before Tue.

Priya: will read them today. any specific logs I should open?

Alex: `/var/log/nginx/prod-access.log` and `model-proxy/error.log` are the two quick ones. Use this grep: `rg "502|error|timeout" /var/log/nginx/prod-access.log -n | tail -n 200`

Priya: got it. one more Q — if the incident needs a rollback, who does that?

Maya: primary does the rollback (or triggers it), secondary assists. We avoid rolling back across zones — prefer variant rollback on pool first. If you're unsure, call out in thread and escalate to Daniel.

Alex: noted. Also adding Priya to the oncall rota for shadowing so she gets pager notifications for the window.

deploy-bot: Added Priya to rota for 2026-05-06 09:00-13:00 UTC (shadow). Notification preference: slack DM enabled.

Priya: thanks! excited to learn.

Maya: one last thing — if you see weird KV eviction errors, check `redis-cli info memory` and our cache-warmup job in namespace `infra-cache`. If you want, I can make a short video walkthrough before I go offline tomorrow.

Priya: a quick video would be awesome.

Maya: I'll record ~20min and drop it here by EOD. :wave:

Alex: great — thanks everyone. I'll send a reminder on Mon with the calendar invite and pre-read checklist.

Daniel: thanks Maya and Alex. See you on Tue for the shadow.

incident-bot: [INFO] Incident 1790001200 marked resolved at 1790003700 — root cause: model variant misconfig + transient pool saturation. Postmortem: https://redwood.infra/incidents/1790001200/postmortem

Maya: perfect — that postmortem will be useful for the shadow walkthrough. Priya, read the postmortem too; it has the exact command sequence we used.

Priya: will do. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
